summary: PATCH /api/snippets/{id} + Edit modal fully VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 38/38 pytest pass in 21.30s. Added 5 new PATCH tests to /app/backend/tests/test_snippets.py covering (a) full-field update + GET-verified persistence, (b) partial update preserving other fields, (c) no-op with only device_id returns current snippet unchanged, (d) wrong device_id returns 403 with data untouched, (e) unknown id returns 404. All 33 prior regression tests still pass (health, projects CRUD, files CRUD, run py/js/ts/html/css + timeout + malformed, chat stream/history/clear, snippets create/list/filter/search/detail/star toggle idempotent/delete authorship guard, TS annotation run). Response bodies confirmed to never leak _id. Frontend @ 390x844 mobile viewport: Published a TEST_EDIT_<ts> snippet (author=TEST_EditUI, tags=orig1,orig2, code console.log('original')). Opened its detail sheet -> detail-edit-btn visible=True on own snippet. Tapped edit -> edit-modal opened with ALL fields prefilled correctly (title=TEST_EDIT_<ts>, desc='orig desc', tags CSV contains 'orig1, orig2', code contains 'original', javascript chip active). Changed title to *_EDITED, code to console.log('EDITED_CODE'), tags to 'edited, ui', tapped save-edit-btn -> modal closed, card in list immediately shows new title, reopened detail confirms EDITED_CODE and #edited tag present. Foreign snippet ('AfterEdit' by EditTester) opened -> detail-edit-btn absent (correctly hidden). Regression: snippet-search-input finds edited snippet, filter-javascript keeps it visible, filter-all + star tap on card also work. MINE tab shows the edited card with delete-mine trash which we used to clean up. Publish flow itself still functional end-to-end.

issues: Sheet footer buttons (detail-edit-btn, detail-insert-btn, submit-publish-btn, save-edit-btn) fall below the visible viewport in a 390x844 preview when the on-screen keyboard would normally be visible. Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' and required a JS .click() to activate. On a real device with a smaller keyboard this still works, but the ScrollView inside the sheet doesn't auto-scroll to reveal the footer — worth confirming on iOS/Android hardware. On web, the sheet's maxHeight:'85%'/'92%' plus KeyboardAvoidingView leaves the footer partially clipped.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — carried over from iter 1-4. Not introduced by this change but still worth migrating. Reference: search for 'pointerEvents=' under /app/frontend/app/*.tsx.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Ensure detail-modal / edit-modal / publish-modal footer buttons remain visible when the sheet is at its max height. Consider using flex:1 on the ScrollView + a sticky footer that doesn't get pushed offscreen, or reducing the sheet's maxHeight so the footer always sits above the safe area.
OPTIONAL (pre-existing): Migrate deprecated `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` in frontend components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_snippet (lines 472-488): correct authorship check via author_device == payload.device_id, 404 for unknown id, 403 for wrong device, no-op returns current snippet, uses projection={'_id':0} so response never leaks Mongo ObjectId. Only non-None fields are set. Clean.
api.ts updateSnippet (lines 73-74) hits PATCH /snippets/{id} with SnippetUpdate typed correctly (device_id required, other fields optional). Matches backend contract exactly.

snippets.tsx EditSnippetModal (lines 659-812) prefills from snippet in useEffect on snippet change, submit builds payload with title/description/language/code/tags + device_id, calls api.updateSnippet and lifts updated snippet to parent for immediate list mutation. Validation (title required, code required) mirrors publish flow.

SnippetDetailModal renders detail-edit-btn only when isMine (line 443-448); parent computes isMine from selected.author_device === deviceId. Foreign snippets correctly hide the Edit button — verified in UI.
snippet card and detail flows continue to display '(you)' suffix and delete-mine trash for own snippets — unchanged from iter 4.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_snippets.py (added 5 PATCH tests: test_patch_updates_fields, test_patch_partial_only_specified_fields, test_patch_no_fields_is_noop, test_patch_forbidden_wrong_device, test_patch_unknown_id_returns_404)

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all Edit-flow requirements + regression (search, lang filter, star, publish, MINE delete, foreign-snippet edit hidden)

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates TEST_-prefixed snippets and self-cleans via test_zzz_cleanup. UI test published TEST_EDIT_<timestamp> then edited then deleted it in the same run via the MINE trash button; no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://drag-code-app.preview.emergentagent.com. `pytest /app/backend/tests/` runs 38 tests in ~21s. Mobile viewport 390x844. Key testIDs for edit flow: detail-edit-btn, edit-modal, edit-title, edit-description, edit-tags, edit-code, edit-lang-<lang>, save-edit-btn, close-edit-btn. When the sheet footer (edit/save/submit buttons) is offscreen due to modal maxHeight, use `page.evaluate("document.querySelector('[data-testid=..]').click()")` instead of page.click(force=True) — Playwright rejects the click because the DOM element's box lies below the 844px viewport. All existing testIDs from iter_4 still work.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works as specified. Only observation is a UX polish item: sheet footer offscreen on 390x844 web preview which required JS-based clicks in Playwright. Not a functional bug.
